CustomField.description: Controls how Buyer Group visibility is indexed. Supported values are Disabled, PairedSource, Embedded, and DualWrite. Blank values fall back to the legacy EnableBuyerGroupAvailability__c behavior.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Disabled, PairedSource, Embedded, or DualWrite. Leave blank only for legacy configs that still rely on EnableBuyerGroupAvailability__c.
CustomField.label: Buyer Group Availability Mode
